## Objective

Assemble the positive-parameter van der Pol two-end result after the central,
pole, and outer matching theorems are complete.

## Dependencies

- [ ] [#2: Positive-parameter Hamiltonian conventions and compact central
      persistence](https://github.com/h-lu/rfsn-ii-positive-parameter-pde/issues/2)
- [ ] [#3: Positive-parameter pole entry and finite part](https://github.com/h-lu/rfsn-ii-positive-parameter-pde/issues/3)
- [ ] [#4: Central--outer matching theorem](https://github.com/h-lu/rfsn-ii-positive-parameter-pde/issues/4)
- [ ] [#5: Positive-parameter algebraic finite part](https://github.com/h-lu/rfsn-ii-positive-parameter-pde/issues/5)

## Proof obligations

- [ ] Pull both end targets and the return target back to one source section
      with uniform mixed \(C^2\) control.
- [ ] Verify a finite clean limiting first-hit arrangement and strict inactive
      face and ordering margins.
- [ ] Apply stratified persistence to obtain a component-by-component census
      with no unlabelled high-winding domains.
- [ ] Prove cross-form, physical spatial-length, and action asymptotics.
- [ ] Prove the exact branch cocycle including both finite parts.
- [ ] Establish symbolic coding only for the graph actually proved exhaustive.
- [ ] Translate bounded or periodic spatial codes to stationary solutions in
      the original PDE variables.
- [ ] State that spatial entropy is not temporal chaos and that temporal
      stability is not part of the theorem.

## Acceptance

Claims V6 and V7 become **Proved** only after the complete dependency chain is
present and independently audited.  If the algebraic end was replaced by a
finite cut, rename and restate this issue before closing it.
